So I wrote this a while ago but was keeping it to myself because I feared it may not be received very well, also the dev team have enough on their plates as it is. There is however Voat brigading currently going on against an innocent user and I feel something must be done to prevent such crap from taking place in the future. The obvious response would have been to wield the ban hammer but I'd like to propose something different:

Algorithmic Processing of SCP and CCP

/v/ideasforvoat

We already have some rules about SCP and CCP but we can extend these to make the community more active and address some concerns like voat brigading and voat whoring and a few other things even before they become a problem.

So currently a new user needs 20 SCP to be able to upvoat and 100 SCP to be able to downvoat. Also we are given 100 upvoads per day.

To expand on that I am proposing the following:

Each Downvoat -20 CCP

This will go a long way in preventing vote brigading. Each user will still be able to downvoat if necessary but you can't spray and pray. A side effect of this is that it also decreases the effectiveness of alt accounts and account aging. Even if a shill buys an aged account it will only be useful until it runs out of CCP.

Creating a new subverse -1000 SCP

Arguably we have quite a few new subverses at this point and we can afford this. This would largely prevent sub squatting but it would also require users to contribute 1000 SCP to other subs before creating their own.

Voting a mod out -1,000,000 CCP

Removing a mod that pisses off the community should not be impossible, but should be extremely difficult. Requiring 1000 people to part with 1000 CCP each seems like a reasonable price. Of course people can vote in the opposite direction in order to keep the mod, it is the same price either way.
Prevent Voat Brigading with CCP Gamification.
I feel like this stops people from expressing their ideals. This place is a safe haven for ideas, and blocking that much behind CCP is the wrong direction.

If the idea needs expressing the user surely can part with a few imaginary internet points to express it. Besides, there is nothing in here that prevents you from laying down your idea in meaningful sentences and just posting it.

Also the current system does nothing to help remove a bad mod. What I propose makes it possible if certain conditions are met. This is something new I believe.

"Paying" for something is not the way. Maybe just have certain requirements, which in my mind, the best one is account age. Much better then forcing users to participate if they want to start their own community

Account aging / account farming was definitely a problem at Reddit and was much abused by PR companies of various description. The same can still happen here if precautions are not taken.

Mine is only one of the possible solutions. Natural CCP decay was another method that was proposed in the past.
Then I vote don't change a thing. I do not like the idea of locking users out because they don;t comment enough (1000 times) to make their own subverse
MGSV: The Phantom Pain "Freedom of Infiltration" Gameplay Demo

I think this would work really well for some specific subverse ideas I've had. It would be nice if mods had the option to do this.

Every time I bring up disabling voting I always see the lame "spam" argument. There's still a report button.

Thoughts?
